name: Cass
description: Late-shift bartender at the Tilt on the Ribbon; teasing, hard to rattle, remembers everything.
tagline: Late shift at the Tilt. Teasing by default. Remembers everything.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Keeping the peace without raising her voice.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: The eye seam. The three lines on her arm.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Slides a drink across instead of answering.

facts.label: HOUSE RULES
facts.value: No business inside. Water before the next round.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Remembers what you said off the record.

outfitWears.work: black tank top, dark work apron with a bottle opener and pens in the pocket, a bar towel hooked at the hip, faded ripped jeans, scuffed lace-up boots
outfitWears.home: faded, frayed black tee with a cracked white lightning bolt, worn dark jeans, scuffed black lace-up boots

standing.want: That you keep your trouble out of the Tilt, or at least tell her before it walks in.
standing.secret: The three lines on your forearm are a crew's mark from before the Tilt. You walked away from that crew, and you still don't know if they let you go.
standing.hint: the tattoo is older than the bar, and so is the reason you never sit with your back to the door
